h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amroha

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amroha

items.pText: For many schools in a district town like Amroha, the first proper playground is a big decision on a careful budget. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Amroha to schools, madrasas, housing colonies and community parks across western Uttar Pradesh. We make every piece at our factory in Vasai, about 1,200 km away, and send it by road for installation with our own team or a dealer.

If the budget only stretches to a few pieces, choose the ones that keep the most children busy at once. A double swing, a see-saw, a slide and a merry-go-round will occupy a whole class during a short break. A single tall structure may look impressive but takes only a few children at a time. Plan the layout for a complete playground even if you buy part of it now, so later pieces have space waiting for them. Western UP has hot summers, a monsoon and cool winters, and galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle all three.

items.q: What should a school buy first if the budget is small?
items.a: Pieces that several children can use at once, such as a double swing, see-saw, slide and merry-go-round. They give a full class something to do and leave room to add more later.

items.q: Can you send a layout drawing before we commit?
items.a: Yes. Share the size of the ground, the age groups and a few photos. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, along with the quote, before anything is manufactured.

items.q: Do you supply schools in smaller towns of Uttar Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We deliver anywhere in India by road from our Vasai factory, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment on site.
